SELECT sku, gtin, name, pack, case_units, case_kg, flow, dc_slot, price_inr, cost_inr
FROM store.products
WHERE lower(name) LIKE '%atta%' OR lower(pack) LIKE '%5 kg%'
ORDER BY sku;

SELECT d.date, d.units_sold, d.revenue_inr,
       f.forecast_units_per_day, f.sigma, f.book_on_hand, f.on_order,
       f.ordered_units, f.method,
       i.book_on_hand_close
FROM store.daily_sales d
LEFT JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.date = d.date AND f.sku = d.sku
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book i ON i.date = d.date AND i.sku = d.sku
WHERE d.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND d.date >= DATE '2026-05-25'
  AND d.date < DATE '2026-07-06'
ORDER BY d.date;

SELECT 'daily_sales' AS source, min(date)::text AS first_ts, max(date)::text AS last_ts, count(*) AS rows
FROM store.daily_sales
UNION ALL
SELECT 'forecasts', min(date)::text, max(date)::text, count(*) FROM store.forecasts
UNION ALL
SELECT 'inventory_book', min(date)::text, max(date)::text, count(*) FROM store.inventory_book
UNION ALL
SELECT 'shelf_audits', min(audit_ts)::text, max(audit_ts)::text, count(*) FROM store.shelf_audits
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stock_counts', min(count_ts)::text, max(count_ts)::text, count(*) FROM store.stock_counts
UNION ALL
SELECT 'pos_lines', min(bill_ts)::text, max(bill_ts)::text, count(*) FROM store.pos_lines
UNION ALL
SELECT 'write_offs', min(date)::text, max(date)::text, count(*) FROM store.write_offs;

SELECT a.audit_ts, a.sku, a.status,
       d.units_sold, i.book_on_hand_close
FROM store.shelf_audits a
LEFT JOIN store.daily_sales d ON d.date = a.audit_ts::date AND d.sku = a.sku
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book i ON i.date = a.audit_ts::date AND i.sku = a.sku
WHERE a.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY a.audit_ts;

SELECT
  (SELECT sum(units_sold) FROM store.daily_sales
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01') AS daily_sales_units,
  (SELECT sum(qty) FROM store.pos_lines
   WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS pos_units_by_sku,
  (SELECT sum(qty) FROM store.pos_lines
   WHERE gtin_scanned = '2900001001014' AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS pos_units_by_gtin,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM store.pos_lines
   WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS pos_lines,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT bill_id) FROM store.pos_lines
   WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS bills;

SELECT c.count_ts, c.sku, c.book_before, c.counted, c.adjustment, c.trigger
FROM store.stock_counts c
WHERE c.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
   OR c.count_ts::date IN (DATE '2026-06-11', DATE '2026-06-12', DATE '2026-06-23',
                           DATE '2026-06-24', DATE '2026-06-25', DATE '2026-06-26')
ORDER BY c.count_ts, c.sku;

sql_calls.sql:
WITH pos AS (
  SELECT bill_ts::date AS date, sum(qty) AS units, count(*) AS lines,
         min(bill_ts) AS first_sale, max(bill_ts) AS last_sale
  FROM store.pos_lines
  WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  GROUP BY bill_ts::date
)
SELECT d.date, d.units_sold, p.lines, p.first_sale, p.last_sale,
       f.forecast_units_per_day, f.sigma, i.book_on_hand_close,
       a.status AS audit_status, a.audit_ts
FROM store.daily_sales d
LEFT JOIN pos p ON p.date = d.date
LEFT JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.date = d.date AND f.sku = d.sku
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book i ON i.date = d.date AND i.sku = d.sku
LEFT JOIN store.shelf_audits a ON a.audit_ts::date = d.date AND a.sku = d.sku
WHERE d.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY d.date;

SELECT p.sku, p.name,
       count(a.*) AS audits,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'on shelf') AS on_shelf_audits,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'empty') AS empty_audits,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'on shelf') / nullif(count(a.*),0), 1) AS audit_osa_pct,
       count(d.*) AS sales_days,
       sum(d.units_sold) AS units_sold,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.units_sold = 0) AS zero_sales_days
FROM store.products p
LEFT JOIN store.shelf_audits a ON a.sku = p.sku
LEFT JOIN store.daily_sales d ON d.sku = p.sku
GROUP BY p.sku, p.name
ORDER BY p.sku;
